method: Structured source/context audit of all 18 canonical numbered chapter outlines, all body figure anchors/captions and nearby targeted prose; checked landing index plus four supporting appendices for overlap. Evidence lines refer to this worktree. Read-only manuscripts/art. Proposals assess coverage and teaching purpose, not every sentence, rendered artwork, quantitative implementation, or learner outcomes. No quota; existing figures stay static unless causal changes add something the prose/static state cannot show. New figures are recommendations, not created assets; animation candidates are storyboards, not implementations. Canonical numbered chapter and appendix order checked against books/config/_quarto-html-vol4.yml and _quarto-pdf-vol4.yml; landing index kept first. Cross-volume duplicate check: Volume I fig-prefill-decode covers the proposed Ch3 core mechanism, so that proposal was withdrawn as a new-art need and retained only as a local reuse/adaptation recommendation.

reuse_opportunities.proposal: Reuse the Volume I mechanism asset/controller with camera/instruction tokens and a small control-specific footer: within one intent-model evaluation prefill creates KV and decode reuses/appends it; the next independent observation rebuilds context. animation_candidates.title: Atomic publication under a stalled proposer
animation_candidates.reason: A reader can collide with an interrupt write, keep its last validated snapshot, and eventually expire its lease even though old data still exist.
sequence: Receive a complete framed proposal into MCU-local memory
Writer marks odd and copies; tick arrives mid-write and rejects the partial snapshot
Writer publishes matching even sequence and tick accepts a whole snapshot
Stall the AP; unchanged mailbox does not renew authority; lease expires and fallback begins
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Snapshot consistency and proposal freshness are independent; no shared AP/MCU memory and no spinning reader.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Choose tick/write phase and stall time; show bounded one-attempt reads rather than a potentially unbounded retry loop.

needs.title: One captured frame, shared pages, and safe buffer reuse
needs.evidence: Lines 1523–1542 contrast three payload-copy stages with dma_buf mappings and explicitly require DMA completion, device ordering/cache maintenance, and consumer ownership before reuse.
needs.existing_coverage: fig-08-capture-to-brake-strip accounts for age but does not show payload identity or the ring-buffer release condition. fig-04-two-processor-implementation concerns small checked proposal records in MCU-local memory, not shared camera payloads. needs.proposal: Matched panels for naive copying and shared physical pages on the application SoC. Show camera DMA → completed frame → ISP/GPU consumers → last-consumer release → requeue. animation_candidates.title: A stale camera edge moves the fingertip
animation_candidates.reason: Composing a capture-time measurement with current wrist kinematics moves the apparent target despite an unchanged object.
sequence: Capture target with wrist pose and epoch
Rotate/move the wrist while retaining the original camera-relative measurement
Compose incorrectly with current pose and expose fingertip offset
Compare the capture-dated composition and its remaining uncertainty
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Frame identity and capture epoch must travel together; a transform tree alone does not enforce temporal consistency.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Vary age/rotation within the declared small-angle illustrative model and expose translational and lever-arm contributions separately.

animation_candidates.title: One ray does not refresh the entire map
animation_candidates.reason: Observed cells change occupancy and epoch; unseen/occluded cells preserve their own evidence dates.
sequence: Show old free/occupied/unknown cells and their epochs
Cast one qualified range return
Update only crossed cells to free and the hit to occupied
Keep behind-hit and off-ray cells unchanged even when the map is republished
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Publication time is not evidence age, and negative evidence is spatially limited.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Choose ray direction and inspect cell epochs; no invented guarantee of global free space.

animation_candidates.title: Clear space shrinks while an occluded person may move
animation_candidates.reason: An unobserved person’s reachable region expands as the certified clearance contracts with evidence age.
sequence: Establish visible and occluded geometry at capture
Grow the hidden actor’s bounded occupancy region
Subtract localization/protective allowances
Stop at the claim’s invalidation horizon; require qualified new evidence to renew it
animation_candidates.systems_takeaway: Memory is a bounded, expiring spatial claim, not a timeless picture of an empty aisle.
animation_candidates.expanded_lab: Scrub evidence age and compare view geometry while preserving the capture-time occlusion; never claim extrapolation renews evidence.

Cross the clear threshold and restore the clock
